emailTemplates.title: Welcome Email
emailTemplates.subject: Welcome to {{company}}!
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for signing up with us. We're thrilled to have you on board. If you have any questions or need help getting started, don't hesitate to reach out.

Best,
{{senderName}}

emailTemplates.title: Follow-Up After No Response

emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I wanted to follow up on my previous message. I understand things get busy — let me know if there's a better time to connect or if you'd prefer I check back later.

Best regards,
{{senderName}}
